package org.schabi.newpipe.database.history.model

import androidx.room3.ColumnInfo
import androidx.room3.Entity
import androidx.room3.ForeignKey
import androidx.room3.ForeignKey.Companion.CASCADE
import androidx.room3.Index
import java.time.OffsetDateTime
import org.schabi.newpipe.database.history.model.StreamHistoryEntity.Companion.JOIN_STREAM_ID
import org.schabi.newpipe.database.history.model.StreamHistoryEntity.Companion.STREAM_ACCESS_DATE
import org.schabi.newpipe.database.history.model.StreamHistoryEntity.Companion.STREAM_HISTORY_TABLE
import org.schabi.newpipe.database.stream.model.StreamEntity
import org.schabi.newpipe.database.stream.model.StreamEntity.Companion.STREAM_ID

/**
 * @param streamUid the stream id this history item will refer to
 * @param accessDate the last time the stream was accessed
 * @param repeatCount the total number of views this stream received
 */
@Entity(
    tableName = STREAM_HISTORY_TABLE,
    primaryKeys = [JOIN_STREAM_ID, STREAM_ACCESS_DATE],
    indices = [Index(value = [JOIN_STREAM_ID])],
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = StreamEntity::class,
            parentColumns = arrayOf(STREAM_ID),
            childColumns = arrayOf(JOIN_STREAM_ID),
            onDelete = CASCADE,
            onUpdate = CASCADE
        )
    ]
)
data class StreamHistoryEntity(
    @ColumnInfo(name = JOIN_STREAM_ID)
    val streamUid: Long,

    @ColumnInfo(name = STREAM_ACCESS_DATE)
    var accessDate: OffsetDateTime,

    @ColumnInfo(name = STREAM_REPEAT_COUNT)
    var repeatCount: Long
) {
    companion object {
        const val STREAM_HISTORY_TABLE: String = "stream_history"
        const val STREAM_ACCESS_DATE: String = "access_date"
        const val JOIN_STREAM_ID: String = "stream_id"
        const val STREAM_REPEAT_COUNT: String = "repeat_count"
    }
}

1	package org.schabi.newpipe.settings
2	
3	import android.content.SharedPreferences
4	import android.content.SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener
5	import android.graphics.Color
6	import android.os.Build
7	import android.os.Bundle
8	import androidx.preference.Preference
9	import androidx.preference.SwitchPreference
10	import com.google.android.material.snackbar.Snackbar
11	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.android.schedulers.AndroidSchedulers
12	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.disposables.Disposable
13	import org.schabi.newpipe.R
14	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.subscription.NotificationMode
15	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.subscription.SubscriptionEntity
16	import org.schabi.newpipe.error.ErrorInfo
17	import org.schabi.newpipe.error.ErrorUtil
18	import org.schabi.newpipe.error.UserAction
19	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.feed.notifications.NotificationHelper
20	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.feed.notifications.NotificationWorker
21	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.feed.notifications.ScheduleOptions
22	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.subscription.SubscriptionManager
23	
24	class NotificationsSettingsFragment : BasePreferenceFragment(), OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener {
25	
26	    private var streamsNotificationsPreference: SwitchPreference? = null
27	    private var notificationWarningSnackbar: Snackbar? = null
28	    private var loader: Disposable? = null
29	
30	    override fun onCreatePreferences(savedInstanceState: Bundle?, rootKey: String?) {
31	        addPreferencesFromResource(R.xml.notifications_settings)
32	        streamsNotificationsPreference = requirePreference(R.string.enable_streams_notifications)
33	
34	        // main check is done in onResume, but also do it here to prevent flickering
35	        updateEnabledState(NotificationHelper.areNotificationsEnabledOnDevice(requireContext()))
36	    }
37	
38	    override fun onStart() {
39	        super.onStart()
40	        defaultPreferences.registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(this)
41	    }
42	
43	    override fun onStop() {
44	        defaultPreferences.unregisterOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(this)
45	        super.onStop()
46	    }
47	
48	    override fun onSharedPreferenceChanged(sharedPreferences: SharedPreferences?, key: String?) {
49	        val context = context ?: return
50	        if (key == getString(R.string.streams_notifications_interval_key) ||
51	            key == getString(R.string.streams_notifications_network_key)
52	        ) {
53	            // apply new configuration
54	            NotificationWorker.schedule(context, ScheduleOptions.from(context), true)
55	        } else if (key == getString(R.string.enable_streams_notifications)) {
56	            if (NotificationHelper.areNewStreamsNotificationsEnabled(context)) {
57	                // Start the worker, because notifications were disabled previously.
58	                NotificationWorker.schedule(context)
59	            } else {
60	                // The user disabled the notifications. Cancel the worker to save energy.
61	                // A new one will be created once the notifications are enabled again.
62	                NotificationWorker.cancel(context)
63	            }
64	        }
65	    }
66	
67	    override fun onResume() {
68	        super.onResume()
69	
70	        // Check whether the notifications are disabled in the device's app settings.
71	        // If they are disabled, show a snackbar informing the user about that
72	        // while allowing them to open the device's app settings.
73	        val enabled = NotificationHelper.areNotificationsEnabledOnDevice(requireContext())
74	        updateEnabledState(enabled)
75	        if (!enabled) {
76	            if (notificationWarningSnackbar == null) {
77	                notificationWarningSnackbar = Snackbar.make(
78	                    listView,
79	                    R.string.notifications_disabled,
80	                    Snackbar.LENGTH_INDEFINITE
81	                ).apply {
82	                    setAction(R.string.settings) {
83	                        NotificationHelper.openNewPipeSystemNotificationSettings(it.context)
84	                    }
85	                    setActionTextColor(Color.YELLOW)
86	                    addCallback(object : Snackbar.Callback() {
87	                        override fun onDismissed(transientBottomBar: Snackbar, event: Int) {
88	                            super.onDismissed(transientBottomBar, event)
89	                            notificationWarningSnackbar = null
90	                        }
91	                    })
92	                    show()
93	                }
94	            }
95	        }
96	
97	        // (Re-)Create loader
98	        loader?.dispose()
99	        loader = SubscriptionManager(requireContext())
100	            .subscriptions()
101	            .observeOn(AndroidSchedulers.mainThread())
102	            .subscribe(this::updateSubscriptions, this::onError)
103	    }
104	
105	    override fun onPause() {
106	        loader?.dispose()
107	        loader = null
108	
109	        notificationWarningSnackbar?.dismiss()
110	        notificationWarningSnackbar = null
111	
112	        super.onPause()
113	    }
114	
115	    private fun updateEnabledState(enabled: Boolean) {
116	        // On Android 13 player notifications are exempt from notification settings
117	        // so the preferences in app should always be available.
118	        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
119	            streamsNotificationsPreference?.isEnabled = enabled
120	        } else {
121	            preferenceScreen.isEnabled = enabled
122	        }
123	    }
124	
125	    private fun updateSubscriptions(subscriptions: List<SubscriptionEntity>) {
126	        val notified = subscriptions.count { it.notificationMode != NotificationMode.DISABLED }
127	        val preference = requirePreference<Preference>(R.string.streams_notifications_channels_key)
128	        preference.summary = "$notified/${subscriptions.size}"
129	    }
130	
131	    private fun onError(e: Throwable) {
132	        ErrorUtil.showSnackbar(
133	            this,
134	            ErrorInfo(e, UserAction.SUBSCRIPTION_GET, "Get subscriptions list")
135	        )
136	    }
137	}
138

1	package org.schabi.newpipe.database.stream.dao
2	
3	import androidx.room3.ColumnInfo
4	import androidx.room3.Dao
5	import androidx.room3.DaoReturnTypeConverters
6	import androidx.room3.Insert
7	import androidx.room3.OnConflictStrategy
8	import androidx.room3.Query
9	import androidx.room3.Transaction
10	import androidx.room3.rxjava3.RxDaoReturnTypeConverters
11	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Completable
12	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Flowable
13	import java.time.OffsetDateTime
14	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.BasicDAO
15	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.stream.model.StreamEntity
16	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.stream.model.StreamEntity.Companion.STREAM_ID
17	import org.schabi.newpipe.extractor.stream.StreamType
18	import org.schabi.newpipe.util.StreamTypeUtil
19	
20	@Dao
21	@DaoReturnTypeConverters(RxDaoReturnTypeConverters::class)
22	abstract class StreamDAO : BasicDAO<StreamEntity> {
23	    @Query("SELECT * FROM streams")
24	    abstract override fun getAll(): Flowable<List<StreamEntity>>
25	
26	    @Query("DELETE FROM streams")
27	    abstract override fun deleteAll(): Int
28	
29	    @Query("SELECT * FROM streams WHERE service_id = :serviceId")
30	    abstract override fun listByService(serviceId: Int): Flowable<List<StreamEntity>>
31	
32	    @Query("SELECT * FROM streams WHERE url = :url AND service_id = :serviceId")
33	    abstract fun getStream(serviceId: Long, url: String): Flowable<List<StreamEntity>>
34	
35	    @Query("UPDATE streams SET uploader_url = :uploaderUrl WHERE url = :url AND service_id = :serviceId")
36	    abstract fun setUploaderUrl(serviceId: Long, url: String, uploaderUrl: String): Completable
37	
38	    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.IGNORE)
39	    internal abstract fun silentInsertInternal(stream: StreamEntity): Long
40	
41	    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.IGNORE)
42	    internal abstract fun silentInsertAllInternal(streams: List<StreamEntity>): List<Long>
43	
44	    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) != 0 FROM streams WHERE url = :url AND service_id = :serviceId")
45	    internal abstract fun exists(serviceId: Int, url: String): Boolean
46	
47	    @Query(
48	        """
49	        SELECT uid, stream_type, textual_upload_date, upload_date, is_upload_date_approximation, duration 
50	        FROM streams WHERE url = :url AND service_id = :serviceId
51	        """
52	    )
53	    internal abstract fun getMinimalStreamForCompare(serviceId: Int, url: String): StreamCompareFeed?
54	
55	    @Transaction
56	    open fun upsert(newerStream: StreamEntity): Long {
57	        val uid = silentInsertInternal(newerStream)
58	
59	        if (uid != -1L) {
60	            newerStream.uid = uid
61	            return uid
62	        }
63	
64	        compareAndUpdateStream(newerStream)
65	
66	        update(newerStream)
67	        return newerStream.uid
68	    }
69	
70	    @Transaction
71	    open fun upsertAll(streams: List<StreamEntity>): List<Long> {
72	        val insertUidList = silentInsertAllInternal(streams)
73	
74	        val streamIds = ArrayList<Long>(streams.size)
75	        for ((index, uid) in insertUidList.withIndex()) {
76	            val newerStream = streams[index]
77	            if (uid != -1L) {
78	                streamIds.add(uid)
79	                newerStream.uid = uid
80	                continue
81	            }
82	
83	            compareAndUpdateStream(newerStream)
84	            streamIds.add(newerStream.uid)
85	        }
86	
87	        update(streams)
88	        return streamIds
89	    }
90	
91	    private fun compareAndUpdateStream(newerStream: StreamEntity) {
92	        val existentMinimalStream = getMinimalStreamForCompare(newerStream.serviceId, newerStream.url)
93	            ?: error("Stream cannot be null just after insertion.")
94	        newerStream.uid = existentMinimalStream.uid
95	
96	        if (!StreamTypeUtil.isLiveStream(newerStream.streamType)) {
97	            // Use the existent upload date if the newer stream does not have a better precision
98	            // (i.e. is an approximation). This is done to prevent unnecessary changes.

Committed as `ea5738228`. Three files improved:

- **`StreamDAO.kt`**: replaced the `ArrayList` + `withIndex` for-loop in `upsertAll` with `insertUidList.zip(streams).map { … }` — eliminates the mutable accumulator, manual index tracking, and `continue` statement, expressing the same logic as a functional transformation.
- **`SuggestionListAdapter.kt`**: `binding.getRoot()` → `binding.root` (Java getter → Kotlin property access).
- **`NotificationsSettingsFragment.kt`**: collapsed `if (!enabled) { if (notificationWarningSnackbar == null) { … } }` into a single `if (!enabled && notificationWarningSnackbar == null) { … }`, removing a level of nesting.
